approved_deltas.delta: Replace visible CIRCA brand copy with Cimoa; preserve geometry and styling.
Do not draw the prototype status bar or Home Indicator; use measured system safe areas.
Guest or expired session goes to Welcome; valid session restores Home; pending local verification resumes its required route.
Hydration or navigation failure exposes an English Retry state without overwriting stored data.

Replace the static native colored fill and faint H5 cPulse with an opaque theme-gradient indeterminate fill anchored at the left, scaleX 0.2 to 2.1 and back over MOTION.splash_progress; preserve the source 150x4 track, 64x4 fill base, brand and safe-area layout. The source motion and capture fields remain historical evidence, not the new animation baseline.

Retain the matching native animated cover while H5 performs the existing startup routing. Release it with a themed crossfade only after the trusted current document's destination, or recoverable Splash error, has painted. Keep stored accounts, consent, session routing and Retry behavior unchanged. New focused evidence is in artifacts/startup-motion.
